Disease Context: Not approved for Brain. Approved in: Lung Non-small Cell Carcinoma
CIViC Statement: Variant is actionable in other tissues. Consult clinical guidelines for cross-applicability.
PubMed Summary: [RESULT] EGFR-TKI resistance is a common and recurrent phenotype in stage IV lung cancer. The EGFP kinase inhibitors gefitinib, erlotinibu, afatinibus, and osimertiniban are effective in EGFT-positive NSCLC, and are a first-line therapy for stage IV NSCCC with EGF mutations. The development of EGFF-TK inhibitors has been facilitated by the development of novel sublines of ER-EGFR mutant NSC cells. The combination of gefitib and bevacizumab is effective in the treatment of eGFR-positive EGFL-positive non-small cell lung cancer (NSCLC) with uncommon EGRR mutations and overcoming acquired C797S resistance. The use of a fatinibinib-based combination therapy is effective and has been shown to be effective in treating EGLR-positive stage IV EGFC.
